subject: Startups
title: The Dashboard Overload Trap
description: A quick win: understand The Dashboard Overload Trap.

hook.text: Some startups track 200 metrics on a dashboard no one reads. More data doesn't mean better decisions.

buildup.text: When everything is measured, nothing stands out. Teams drown in charts and lose focus on what actually matters.

discovery.text: The best companies pick 3–5 key metrics that reflect the health of the business. Everything else is secondary.

twist.text: Stripe reportedly focused on just two metrics for years: payment volume and number of API requests.

climax.text: Fewer metrics force clarity. If you can't explain your startup's health in five numbers, you don't understand it.

punchline.text: Track five metrics well. Ignore the other 195.

quiz.question: What problem does tracking too many metrics create?
options: Teams lose focus on what actually matters
